international.title: Microsoft scrambles to fix global outage affecting Teams and Outlook
international.summary: Tech company ‘seeing positive results’ with efforts and says no indication problem was caused by cyber-attack Microsoft outage hits UK hospitals, GPs, schools and police Microsoft outage – live updates Tell us: have you been affected by the outage? Microsoft is scrambling to fix an outage of some of its systems that has caused huge disruption to users, organisations and businesses across the globe. In its latest update, the tech company said it was seeing “early signs of stabilisation” in its efforts to improve capacity to enable more users to get back on its systems, after a global outage affected millions of users for more than 12 hours on Thursday and Friday.
